intent: Split three of the largest remaining linux_configuration scripts, and defer a fourth whose seam cannot be made lint-clean without a suppression.
changes: Three cuts each for organize_downloads.sh and setup_kcd2_dice_solver.sh, two for fix_ubuntu_performance.sh. These are the first 490+ line scripts done, and every one needed more than one seam.

Repeated splitting chained the libs - each new lib sourced the next, because the tool inserts its source line relative to the file it just wrote. Flattened so organize_downloads.sh sources all three directly and no lib sources a sibling, and removed a leftover SCRIPT_DIR the chain had left in a lib.

diagnose_pacman_hook_stall.sh was reverted to HEAD. Its transaction runner assigns LAST_ELAPSED which the caller reads, and reads PACMAN_BIN which the caller defines; linted as a fragment that is SC2034 plus SC2153, and the pre-commit hook lints each lib in isolation. Neither is a real bug, which is exactly why suppressing them would be wrong - the honest answer is that this seam does not exist.

verification.evidence: organize_downloads.sh first reported SC1091 for a lib sourcing a sibling; after flattening, all three report 'libs sourced, functions defined'.

Failed on the pacman lib's SC2034/SC2153. This is the check that matters here and is stricter than shellcheck -x on the entry script, which passed on the same code - the hook lints each lib alone, with no view of the caller's globals. Passes now that the split is reverted.

verification.command: systemctl cat media-organizer.service, test -f its ExecStart, bash -n that file
verification.evidence: Resolves to organize_downloads.sh and parses. This is one of only two units pointing into the repo, and it is the script that shrank most in this batch (513 -> 72).

verification.command: git checkout HEAD -- diagnose_pacman_hook_stall.sh, then shellcheck -x
verification.evidence: Restored to 493 lines and clean. Note the first `git checkout` without HEAD restored the staged split rather than the original - checked with wc -l, not assumed.
None of the three entry scripts or seven libs is listed.

risks: None of the three was run. organize_downloads.sh moves files in ~/Downloads and runs from a live systemd timer; verifying it by running would be exactly the mutation decision 6 forbids. The unit-path check and bash -n are the strongest available evidence.
The lib-chaining bug now has two instances (20-dump-stock.sh, organize_downloads.sh). Any script split more than twice needs its source lines grepped afterwards; the tool does not do this itself.
diagnose_pacman_hook_stall.sh remains at 493 lines, the largest deferred file. Splitting it needs the LAST_ELAPSED/PACMAN_BIN state passed explicitly rather than shared.
rollback: git revert the commit; the three scripts return to their previous sizes and the seven libs disappear.
After rollback, re-run bash -n and shellcheck on the restored scripts.
